title: Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - October 1, 2025
title_cn: 《守望先锋2》正式服补丁说明 - 2025年10月1日
note:
### Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - October 1, 2025

#### Stadium Updates

Stadium Competitive updates

* Fixed an issue where players near their predicted rank started to gain extremely low Stadium Points.
* We have adjusted the Stadium Ranked distribution curve to make it easier to reach Elite rank for most players.
* We have made adjustments to reduce the amount of Stadium Points lost when players lose a match, as each round won now provides a greater reduction in the overall point loss.
* We have made adjustments to the maximum and minimum amount of Stadium Points that can be won or lost from a competitive match.

Developer Comments: The dynamic updates to Stadium Competitive have made progressing in the system feel more difficult as players are now finding their predicted ranks faster. We are making improvements to smooth out this experience and will keep a close eye on this as we head into Season 19.

#### Damage

![Freja](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/kpR8/256X256/828848437c49bc5ed4a2cf900c85986a4af265d71d1ea9ddf260b8a0236f71a9-t.png)

##### Freja

Developer Comments: Freja has had the lowest winrate in Stadium for an extended period of time, so we're adding some more consistency to her builds to make her more competitive amongst the DPS roster. We're aware she has a very high damage ceiling in the right hands, so these changes are aimed at helping her consistency but not raise her damage ceiling or one shot capabilities.

Lille Fælde - Power

* Increased effectiveness to 30% reduced effectiveness (up from 40% reduced effectiveness).

Seismic Shot - Power

* Increased explosion radius increased to 50% (up from 33%).

Forager - Power

* Increased Max Life Heal per shot to 5% (up from 4%).

Deep Pockets - Power

* Ammo Restore on Ability Use increased to 40% (up from 25%).

Volley à Deux - Power

* Increased damage on additional bolts to 50% reduced (up from 66% reduced).

![Tracer](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/f9uG/256X256/5ee20a1feed14da5153f19745328e9fc02bd79f8109593a9b7dab9283eb9629b-t.png)

##### Tracer

Developer Comments: Tracer has been performing well across the board. We're making it a bit harder for her to reach high amounts of health to make sure there is still risk involved in her engagements. We're also hitting some of her Weapon focused Powers with a few buffs to her other builds. We'll be continuing to keep a very close eye on Tracer as we know she has a very strong relationship with Stadium's stat increases.

Chronal Crux - Stadium Passive

* Now gains 35% less Health, Armor, and Shields from items and cash (previously 25% less).

Alternate Ending - Power

* Healing increased to 100% of damage taken (up from 75%).

Blink of An Eye - Power

* Cooldown reduction reduced to 0.04s (down from 0.05s).

Foresight - Power

* Auto-aim reduced to 4 shots (down from 6).

Temportal - Power

* Increased the portal's duration to 8s (up from 6s).

Chrono Bomb - Epic Ability Hero Item

* Increased Ability Power to 20% (up from 15%).
* Increased cost to 10500 (up from 10000).

#### Support

![Brigitte](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/NzuC/256X256/51b93ea59f369a1defa78e5d08c12b1391f5d2d94614a51fd95c125a7a6151fa-t.png)

##### Brigitte

Developer Comments: Brigitte's damage buff to Shield Bash in the core game in the midseason proved to be a large unintended damage buff for Sköldkastning and it has been overperforming. We're bringing down the bonus damage to be more in line with her other powers to ensure variety in her build paths.

Sköldkastning - Power

* Shield Boomerang damage reduced to 40% of Shield Bash damage (down from 60%).

#### Armory

##### General Item Updates

Codebreaker - Epic General Weapon Item

* Cost increased to 10000 (up from 9000).

#### Bug Fixes

Heroes

Mercy

* Fixed an issue with the animation and voice line of Mercy's Ultimate in Overwatch Classic.

Wuyang

* Fixed an issue where Wuyang's Ultimate sometimes targeted closer enemies than intended.

Maps

Aatlis

* Fixed an issue with the stairs in Aatlis and the map has been re-enabled.

Stadium

Moira

* Fixed an issue where Moira's Power Optimal Overflow spawned Biotic Orbs without reduced duration.

Pharah

* Fixed an issue where Pharah's Triple Volley rockets dealt more damage than intended.

Reinhardt

* Fixed an issue where Reinhardt's Power Shield Stampede caused camera to not lock in place during Charge.

Soldier: 76

* Fixed an issue where Soldier 76's Power Peripheral Pulse didn't deal reduced damage to additional targets during Tactical Visor.

### 《守望先锋2》正式服补丁说明 - 2025年10月1日

#### 角斗领域更新

角斗领域竞技模式更新

* 修复了玩家在接近预估段位时获得的角斗点数极低的问题。
* 我们调整了角斗领域排位分布曲线，使大多数玩家更容易达到精英段位。
* 我们进行了调整，减少了玩家输掉比赛时扣除的角斗点数，现在获胜的每一回合都会更大幅度地减少总扣分。
* 我们调整了竞技比赛中获得或扣除的角斗点数的上限和下限。

开发者评论：角斗领域竞技模式的动态更新使得系统中的晋级感觉更加困难，因为玩家现在能更快地达到预估段位。我们正在进行改进以平滑这一体验，并将在进入第19赛季时密切关注这一点。

#### 输出

![Freja](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/kpR8/256X256/828848437c49bc5ed4a2cf900c85986a4af265d71d1ea9ddf260b8a0236f71a9-t.png)

##### 弗蕾娅

开发者评论：弗蕾娅在角斗领域中的胜率长期以来一直是最低的，因此我们正在增加她构建的一致性，使她在输出英雄阵容中更具竞争力。我们意识到她在合适的人手中拥有极高的伤害上限，因此这些改动旨在帮助她的稳定性，而不是提高她的伤害上限或秒杀能力。

Lille Fælde - 强化

* 效果提高至降低30%的效果（原为降低40%的效果）。

震荡射击 - 强化

* 爆炸半径增加幅度提高至50%（原为33%）。

搜寻者 - 强化

* 每次射击的最大生命值治疗量提高至5%（原为4%）。

深口袋 - 强化

* 使用技能时的弹药恢复量提高至40%（原为25%）。

双重齐射 - 强化

* 额外箭矢的伤害提高至降低50%（原为降低66%）。

![Tracer](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/f9uG/256X256/5ee20a1feed14da5153f19745328e9fc02bd79f8109593a9b7dab9283eb9629b-t.png)

##### 猎空

开发者评论：猎空在各方面的表现都很出色。我们稍微增加了她获得高额生命值的难度，以确保她的交战仍存在风险。我们还削弱了她一些侧重武器的强化，并增强了她的其他构建。我们将继续密切关注猎空，因为我们知道她与角斗领域的属性增长有着非常密切的关系。

时间枢纽 - 角斗领域被动

* 现在从物品和现金中获得的生命值、护甲和护盾减少35%（原为减少25%）。

另类结局 - 强化

* 治疗量提高至受到伤害的100%（原为75%）。

眨眼之间 - 强化

* 冷却缩减降低至0.04秒（原为0.05秒）。

先见之明 - 强化

* 自动瞄准减少至4发（原为6发）。

临时传送门 - 强化

* 传送门持续时间增加至8秒（原为6秒）。

时空炸弹 - 史诗级技能英雄物品

* 技能强度提高至20%（原为15%）。
* 费用增加至10500（原为10000）。

#### 支援

![Brigitte](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/NzuC/256X256/51b93ea59f369a1defa78e5d08c12b1391f5d2d94614a51fd95c125a7a6151fa-t.png)

##### 布丽吉塔

开发者评论：布丽吉塔在季中更新的核心游戏中对能量盾击的伤害增强，被证明是对“盾牌投掷”的一个巨大的意外伤害增强，且表现过强。我们将降低其额外伤害，使其与其他强化更加一致，以确保她构建路径的多样性。

盾牌投掷 - 强化

* 盾牌回旋镖伤害降低至能量盾击伤害的40%（原为60%）。

#### 军械库

##### 通用物品更新

破译者 - 史诗级通用武器物品

* 费用增加至10000（原为9000）。

#### 错误修复

英雄

天使

* 修复了《守望先锋经典版》中天使终极技能的动画和语音台词的问题。

无漾

* 修复了无漾的终极技能有时会锁定比预期更近的敌人的问题。

地图

阿特利斯

* 修复了阿特利斯地图中楼梯的问题，该地图已重新启用。

角斗领域

莫伊拉

* 修复了莫伊拉的强化“优化溢出”生成的生化之球没有减少持续时间的问题。

法老之鹰

* 修复了法老之鹰的“三重齐射”火箭造成的伤害高于预期的问题。

莱因哈特

* 修复了莱因哈特的强化“盾牌冲锋”导致冲锋期间镜头未锁定的问题。

士兵：76

* 修复了士兵：76的强化“外围脉冲”在战术目镜期间未对额外目标造成降低伤害的问题。
